repairs.quote: While in Brush, Rengar leaps to enemies he Attacks. Rengar generates 1 Ferocity when he uses a non-ultimate Ability. At the start of the leap Unseen Predator will generate 1 Ferocity if none of his current Ferocity was generated this way. At 4 Ferocity, his next non-ultimate Ability is empowered. Casting an empowered Ability grants Rengar (30% ~ 50%) Move Speed for 1.5 seconds. Unique takedowns increase Rengar's Attack Damage from Bonetooth Necklace.
